e7_s4_rationale: The presence of a renal mass with areas of fat attenuation, visible vessels extending into the renal cortex, and a fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein extending to the inferior vena cava are highly suggestive of renal cell carcinoma with vascular extension.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Angiomyolipoma with renal vein thrombosis

e7_s4_rejected.label: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: This is a subtype of renal cell carcinoma, but the provided information does not specifically suggest clear cell characteristics over other types of renal cell carcinoma with vascular extension.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Papillary renal cell carcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Papillary renal cell carcinoma does not typically present with the combination of fat attenuation and vascular extension seen in this case.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma is less likely given the presence of fat attenuation and vascular invasion, which are not characteristic features of this subtype.
